guard: the advertised tool surface and the orientation card gate on AUTHENTICATED (static creds or user-mode auth), never on "has static creds", and open mode and token mode stay ungated
_note: No completionMarker on purpose. This suite is fail-fast (node:assert throws at the first red), so its only terminal line is a success banner, and a killed run by construction never reaches it. Declaring it graded all five genuine kills INCONCLUSIVE — the exact inversion mutation-proof.mjs documents at its marker check: a fail-fast suite with no line common to both outcomes should not declare one.
why: The defect (#740) is one expression read in the wrong dimension, so the kills are split by the
direction each cell has to hold rather than by line. A1 restores the exact defect and must be
caught by the user-auth cell; A2 restores it at the second site, the orientation card's access
line, which nothing on the wire would correct.
A3 and A4 are the regression guard, and they are the reason it exists. Gating open mode as well
is the natural way to get this wrong, so A3 removes the open-mode escape and must be caught by
the open-mode cell. A4 is the subtler half: counting a shared connection token as an identity
plane looks like completeness and is not, because a token connection carries no owner+actor
grant and no per-agent publish ACL, so the broker gates nothing per agent for it and hiding the
tools there is the same untruth pointing the other way.
A5 keeps the fix from degrading into a blanket hide. It leaves static creds alone on purpose:
an unconditional hide is already caught by cell 1, which would grade a kill without saying
anything about the user-auth cells this change added. Breaking ONLY the user-auth branch is
what makes the kill a statement about 6b.

mutations.name: A1 the defect itself — gate on "has static creds" again, so a user-auth agent reads as open mode
mutations.expectRed: 740:user-auth without the spawn capability must not be advertised cotal_spawn

mutations.name: A2 the second site — the orientation card calls a broker-enforced user-auth mesh "open mode"
mutations.expectRed: 740:a user-auth mesh is auth mode, not open mode, on the orientation card

mutations.name: A3 THE REGRESSION — gate open mode too, by dropping the unauthenticated escape entirely
mutations.expectRed: 740:open mode must still be advertised cotal_spawn with no capability

mutations.name: A4 over-reach the other way — treat a shared connection token as an identity plane
mutations.expectRed: 740:token mode is not an identity plane and must still be advertised cotal_spawn

mutations.name: A5 a blanket hide on the user-auth plane — the capability stops granting anything there
mutations.expectRed: 740:user-auth with the spawn capability must still be advertised cotal_spawn
